title: Elkhart USD 218 Deploys ZeroEyes AI Gun Detection and Intelligent Situational Awareness Technology
description: Kansas Unified School District Strengthens Campus Safety with Proactive Security Solution PHILADELPHIA, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ZeroEyes, creators of the leading multi-analytics weapons detection and threat intelligence platform, today announced that its AI gun detection and intelligent situational awareness platform has been deployed by Kansas’ Elkhart USD 218 to help protect students, staff, and visitors against gun-related violence. Located in a rural community, Elkhart USD 218 serves approximately 325 students from elementary through high school, supported by 55 staff members across three school buildings. As part of its commitment to student and staff safety, the district is modernizing its security infrastructure with a new camera system and upgraded card reader access controls. The deployment of ZeroEyes adds an additional layer of protection to the district’s broader security strategy, helping provide advanced situational awareness and faster response capabilities in the event of a potential threat. The district secured funding through the Kansas Safe and Secure Firearm Detection Grant Program, administered by the Office of the Kansas Attorney General, to purchase and implement the software. "At Elkhart, the safety of our students and faculty is our top priority, and we are excited to add ZeroEyes visual firearm detection as part of that commitment. What makes ZeroEyes stand out is the great and knowledgeable staff you get to work with. The integration was seamless, and their response time is quick,” said Cole Parks, IT Director and Athletic Director, Elkhart USD 218. "We’re proud to support Elkhart USD 218 by adding another layer of proactive protection to the district,” said Mike Lahiff, co-founder and CEO of ZeroEyes. "Thanks to the support of the Office of the Attorney General, Kansas schools can adopt innovative technology that helps strengthen safety and provide greater peace of mind for their communities.” ZeroEyes' AI weapons detection and intelligent situational awareness software layers onto existing digital security cameras. If a weapon is identified, images are instantly shared with the ZeroEyes Operations Center (ZOC), the industry's only U.S.-based, fully in-house operation center, which is staffed 24/7/365 by specially trained U.S. military and law enforcement veterans. If these experts determine the threat is valid, they dispatch alerts and actionable intelligence - including visual description, weapons type, and last known location - to law enforcement and school security teams, often in a matter of seconds from the moment a weapon is detected. About ZeroEyes ZeroEyes delivers an integrated suite of analytics and security tools, including capabilities such as weapons detection, real-time threat geolocation and more, designed to enhance preparedness, accelerate threat identification, and enable effective response. It provides real-time detection and actionable information for visibly brandished weapons, such as guns and knives, and alerts local staff and law enforcement with images and precise location often in a matter of seconds from the moment a gun is detected. Founded in 2018 by Navy SEALs and elite technologists, the company pioneered human-verified gun detection to help organizations mitigate and respond to gun-related incidents. Its patented technology has been recognized by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) as an effective anti-terrorism solution and was the first AI-based gun detection platform to achieve full SAFETY Act Designation. Building on its proven success in firearm detection, having verified over thousands of accurate firearm detections, ZeroEyes expanded its platform to address the full spectrum of modern security challenges, from defending to detecting and responding to threats. ZeroEyes’ platform is deployed in thousands of locations across SLED, federal and defense, and commercial enterprise customers in the US, Mexico, the Caribbean, Latin America (LATAM), and India. The company also provides security assessments, system integration support, and active shooter preparedness training. Headquartered in the Greater Philadelphia area, the company continues to advance its platform using a proprietary dataset of millions of images and videos, delivering high accuracy and reliability as security needs evolve. Learn more at ZeroEyes.com. ZeroEyes Media Contact: media@ZeroEyes.com Elkhart USD 218 Contact: Cole Parks, cparks@usd218.org

title: Unhedged Connects AI Assistants to Esports, Crypto and Sports Prediction Markets
description: Users can research markets, review positions and place trades through compatible AI assistants, with access controlled by permissions they choose. Singapore, SG, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Unhedged, a prediction markets platform covering esports, cryptocurrency and sports, has released new tools that let users research markets, review their positions and place trades through compatible AI assistants. The announcement includes an updated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and a new TypeScript software development kit (SDK). Unhedged’s MCP server and TypeScript SDK connect AI assistants and developer applications to prediction market research, account information and trading tools. With Unhedged MCP, users can connect assistants such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more to their Unhedged account. From a conversation, they can find markets, examine the rules that determine outcomes and review existing positions. When trading permissions are enabled, the assistant can also place and manage orders. For example, a user can ask an assistant to find active Bitcoin markets, explain their resolution criteria and review the user's related positions. The connection gives the assistant tools to retrieve that information directly from Unhedged and bring it into the conversation. Unhedged keeps individual positions, trade sizes and trading activity private from other users. Traders can explore esports, crypto and sports markets without making those account details visible to other participants on the platform. Access for connected tools is controlled through scoped API keys. Account information and trading functions require the corresponding permissions, allowing users to choose which capabilities they grant to an assistant or application. For developers, the new TypeScript SDK provides a typed client for building research tools, portfolio dashboards and trading integrations. It supports market discovery, account balances, positions, trading history, quotes and order management. Optional WebSocket clients provide public order-book snapshots and authenticated account events. Developers can begin querying public market data without an API key. The release pairs MCP server version 0.3.1 with TypeScript SDK version 0.1.0. Both packages are available through npm for Node.js 20 or later. Eligible users can explore markets on Unhedged or connect an assistant through the MCP setup guide. Developers can get started with the TypeScript SDK installation instructions. About Unhedged Unhedged is a prediction markets platform covering esports, cryptocurrency, sports and other real-world events. Individual positions, trade sizes and trading activity are private from other users. Its web app, API, MCP server and TypeScript SDK provide ways to explore markets and manage trading activity. Prediction markets involve substantial risk of loss. Never trade more than you can afford to lose. Participation is subject to age and jurisdiction requirements in the Terms of Service. Press Inquiries Unhedged contact [at] unhedged.gg https://unhedged.gg
